testsuite.name: com.carecompanion.app.ui.elder.ElderExperienceTest

testcase.name: no videos shows the no-videos message, not the no-contacts message
no medicines due shows the friendly empty message
contacts render with names and tapping opens a call confirmation, not a dial
high contrast and enlarged font render without crashing and content is displayed
Marathi language renders translated contacts-empty string
Hindi language renders translated strings on the home screen
tapping No dismisses the confirmation without calling
a pending dose shows medicine name, time, and separately-tappable Taken vs Not-taken
no contacts shows the no-contacts message
a contact with no photo still renders its name (silhouette fallback, no crash)
